title: The Broken Average
description: average_of_three(a, b, c) should return the average of three numbers. It works for zeros, then falls apart.
code:
def average_of_three(a, b, c):
    return a + b + c / 3
solution:
def average_of_three(a, b, c):
    return (a + b + c) / 3
hint: Division happens before addition. Which part of the expression is actually divided by 3?
explanation: `/` binds tighter than `+`, so the code computes `a + b + (c / 3)`. Wrap the sum in parentheses so the whole total is divided: `(a + b + c) / 3`.
